text:
Clara: heads up — drafting a tiny launch pack focused on latency vs cost. want very snackable charts for social + a quick webinar hook. thoughts?
James: love snackable. can we keep to 3 visuals max? social wants single-image story.
Noah: +1. my vote: (1) 'tokens -> $' simple bar (2) latency SLO vs cost curve (3) throughput per GPU for common models.
Elaine: callout — show what customers actually care about: 95th pct latency and cost per 1k tokens. avoid deep model names.
Clara: agreed. copy idea: "Same model, different serving choices — trade latency for cost. Pick what matters." short.
James: CTA options: 1) sign up for live demo 2) webinar sign-up 3) calc tool link. which routes to inbound?
Noah: route logic: calc tool -> self-serve; webinar -> leads to SDR for mid-market; demo -> AE. should tag by ARR signal in form.
Elaine: for webinar hook: 20min on real numbers — "How we cut token spend 40% while keeping 95th latency under 200ms". keep bold number.
Clara: design notes for charts: use consistent color for "fast path" vs "cheap path". label axes: tokens (x) and $/1k (y) for first.
James: can we make a tiny interactive for blog? a slider: push SLO and show estimated $/1k. if not, GIF sequence of 3 frames.
Noah: GIF fine for social. interactive for product pages -> later. engineer ask: can we get sample numbers from infra?
Elaine: I can pull a representative table: hosted defaults vs dedicated reserved vs private optimized. will anonymize customer names.
Clara: perfect. also want 2 short social captions: one technical (for eng audiences) and one benefit-focused (for PMs/biz).
James: technical caption: "Match latency SLOs to running costs: real measurements across serving modes."
Noah: benefit caption: "Same app, lower bill or faster responses — pick your tradeoff."
Clara: inbound routing details for forms: add a dropdown "Primary priority" with options: Cost / Latency / Compliance. map Cost->calc tool, Latency->demo, Compliance->private-sales.
Elaine: also add a hidden field for token volume estimate to prioritize. SDRs want >100M tokens flagged.
mktg-bot: scheduled reminder set for 1743298745 to review final creative. :calendar:
James: timeline: mockups by Wed, copy + routing by Fri, engineering numbers by EOD Thu.
Clara: ok i'll assemble a draft deck for review. small ask: avoid the word "benchmark" in public posts — we should call them "performance snapshots." 
Noah: noted. keeps us flexible.
Clara: thanks all — will share draft in #marketing tomorrow. :sparkles:
